probe_artifact_warning: Python-urllib's default User-Agent trips Cloudflare 'error code: 1010' on several hosts and returns 403 BEFORE auth. An urllib-only audit falsely reported Groq and Cerebras as dead. Always probe providers with curl (or a browser UA), and treat 403+'error code: 1010' as a client-fingerprint block, never as a bad key.
